title: Air fryer Black Friday deals 2026 UK: prices to wait for
seoTitle: Air Fryer Black Friday Deals 2026 UK: Target Prices
description: Air fryer deals ahead of Black Friday 2026, from £29 budget baskets to Ninja dual-drawers, with last year's sale prices so you know when to buy.
intro:
**Short answer: budget air fryers are already at Black Friday prices, with the Tower Vortx 4L at £29 and the Tower Vortx 8L dual-drawer at £75 on Very.** Big-name dual-drawer models, especially Ninja, were noticeably cheaper last Black Friday than they are today, so it's worth waiting until late November for those.

We update this page as prices move. These prices were checked on 26 October 2026.

deals.note: The same price Very charged last Black Friday. A cheap, simple single basket for one or two people.

deals.name: Tower Vortx 8L dual basket air fryer with viewing windows
deals.note: The budget way to get two drawers. Windows let you check food without opening the drawer. Tower's larger 9L dual was £69.99 on Amazon last Black Friday, so this is fair rather than a steal.

deals.note: Currys is the same price. A Bosch Series 4 dual was reported at £99.99 on Amazon during October's Prime sale, so it can go lower.

deals.note: £50 off in white only; grey is still £239.99. A big family-sized dual-drawer. Ninja's Dual Zone models dropped to around £160 last Black Friday, so this could fall further.

deals.note: Amazon had it for £199.97 earlier this month, so £230 isn't the price to pay. Wait for £200 or less. It's the one to get if counter space is tight.

body:
## Air fryer prices to aim for this Black Friday

These are the prices popular air fryers hit around last year's Black Friday sales (late November 2025). If you see one at or below this figure, it's a genuinely good deal.

- **Ninja Foodi MAX Dual Zone (AF400UK):** £154–£159 (often £209 to £230)
- **Ninja Foodi Dual Zone (AF300UK):** £125–£128
- **Ninja Double Stack XL:** about £188–£200
- **Ninja FlexDrawer (AF500UK):** about £184 (its recent low)
- **Ninja CRISPi:** £117
- **Tower Vortx 9L dual (T17088):** £69.99
- **Tefal Dual Easy Fry (EY901HG0):** £79.98
- **Philips 3000 Dual (NA352/00):** about £100
- **Cosori Dual 8.5L:** £114
- **Russell Hobbs SatisFry:** £88

## Which air fryer should you buy?

**Size first.** Which? suggests under 5 litres for one or two people, 5–7 litres for three to five, and over 7.5 litres for bigger households. If you want to cook a whole chicken, look for at least 6–8 litres.

**Single or dual drawer?** A single basket is smaller and easier to clean, but you'll batch-cook bigger meals. Two drawers let you cook chicken and chips at different temperatures and finish them together, which is why most families end up with one. Stacked models like the Ninja Double Stack give you two drawers in the footprint of one.

**Do you need Ninja?** Not necessarily. Which? has found several air fryers under £100 that cook as well as ones over £150. Ninja's advantage is build quality and reliable sync features. For a first air fryer, a Tower or Tefal at a good price is a sensible buy.

## Is an air fryer cheaper to run than an oven?

Yes, for small meals. In Which?'s October 2026 tests at the current 26.32p per kWh, a roast chicken cost 14p in an air fryer against 30p in an oven, and chips cost 8p against 23p. The savings shrink if you're cooking for a crowd and have to run several batches.

## When do air fryer prices drop?

Black Friday 2026 is on **Friday 27 November**, and Cyber Monday on **30 November**. Ninja usually cuts prices in the week before, and Amazon, Argos, Currys and Very tend to match within hours. Budget brands like Tower are already at or near their low, so there's less reason to wait.

### Is it worth waiting for Black Friday to buy an air fryer?

For Ninja and other premium dual-drawer models, usually yes: last year many were £50 to £80 cheaper than today. For budget single-basket models, the saving from waiting is small.

### Which air fryer is best for a family of four?

A dual-drawer model of at least 7.5 litres, such as the Ninja Foodi MAX Dual Zone or the Tower Vortx 8L dual if you're on a budget.

### Are Black Friday air fryer deals real?

Many are, but watch the 'was' prices. Several air fryers today show reference prices that are months out of date. Compare against the target prices above rather than the percentage off.

### Do I need Prime for Amazon's air fryer deals?

Some Amazon Black Friday prices are for Prime members only. Our [Amazon Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) explains how to time a trial.

See also our [Ninja Black Friday deals 2026](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/) guide and [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).
